raw.result: {"facts":[{"statement":"A player may place any number of their unallocated dice onto available utility slots.","sourceSentence":"You may place any number of unallocated dice on available utility slots."},{"statement":"Each utility slot may be used only once per turn.","sourceSentence":"Each utility slot can only be used once per turn, and all dice you intend to place into utility slots must be placed there and immediately resolved (re-rolled or modified) before any of them can be re-allocated to either shields or part damage.","numericValue":{"magnitude":1,"unit":"uses per turn per utility slot","approximate":false}},{"statement":"All dice a player intends to use on utility slots must be placed and immediately resolved before any of them may be re-allocated to shields or part damage.","sourceSentence":"Each utility slot can only be used once per turn, and all dice you intend to place into utility slots must be placed there and immediately resolved (re-rolled or modified) before any of them can be re-allocated to either shields or part damage."},{"statement":"Placing a die on a dice modifier slot immediately rotates and changes its face value by one pip up or down.","sourceSentence":"When placing a die on a dice modifier slot, immediately rotate and modify its face value by +/-1 pip.","numericValue":{"magnitude":1,"unit":"pip","approximate":false}},{"statement":"A die modified on a dice modifier slot stays on that utility slot until all other utility dice have been resolved.","sourceSentence":"Leave it on its utility slot until all other utility dice have been resolved."},{"statement":"A six may not be changed into a one, and a one may not be changed into a six, via the modifier slot.","sourceSentence":"Note: Sixes may NOT be changed to ones and ones may NOT be changed to sixes."},{"statement":"Placing a die on a re-roll slot immediately re-rolls that die, and it is placed back on the slot until all other utility dice are resolved.","sourceSentence":"When placing a die on a re-roll slot, immediately re-roll it and place it back on the slot until all other utility dice are resolved."},{"statement":"A die that has been re-rolled cannot afterwards be placed on a +/- slot for further modification.","sourceSentence":"Once a die is re-rolled, it cannot be placed on a +/- slot to be further modified."},{"statement":"After all utility dice are resolved, the player removes them from their card and allocates them to shields or damage if possible.","sourceSentence":"Once all utility dice are resolved (i.e. re-rolled or modified +/-1), remove them from your card and allocate them to either shields or damage, if possible."},{"statement":"Unallocated dice that cannot be played count as spent at the end of the player's turn.","sourceSentence":"Unallocated dice that cannot be played are considered spent at the end of your turn."},{"statement":"A player may place unallocated dice, including ones modified via utility slots, onto available shield slots.","sourceSentence":"You may place unallocated dice (including dice that have been modified via utility slots) to the available shield slots, gaining shield strength equal to the total face value of all dice placed there."},{"statement":"Shield strength gained equals the sum of the face values of all dice placed on shield slots.","sourceSentence":"You may place unallocated dice (including dice that have been modified via utility slots) to the available shield slots, gaining shield strength equal to the total face value of all dice placed there."},{"statement":"In a normal game, at most 4 dice may be placed on shields per turn.","sourceSentence":"In a normal game, no more than 4 dice can be placed this way per turn.","numericValue":{"magnitude":4,"unit":"dice per turn","approximate":false}},{"statement":"In Hard Mode, at most 3 dice may be placed on shields per turn.","sourceSentence":"In Hard Mode, no more than 3 dice can be placed this way per turn.","numericValue":{"magnitude":3,"unit":"dice per turn","approximate":false}},{"statement":"Dice placed on shields do not carry over between rounds; they are re-rolled at the start of the player's next turn.","sourceSentence":"Additionally, dice used for shields do not persist from round to round. They're re-rolled at the start of your next turn."},{"statement":"A player deals 1 damage to a machine part by fulfilling that part's roll conditions and allocating the required dice to it.","sourceSentence":"You may deal 1 damage to a given machine part by successfully fulfilling the roll conditions (on the middle right side of the card) and allocating the required dice to the part.","numericValue":{"magnitude":1,"unit":"damage","approximate":false}},{"statement":"A machine part's roll conditions are printed on the middle right side of its card.","sourceSentence":"You may deal 1 damage to a given machine part by successfully fulfilling the roll conditions (on the middle right side of the card) and allocating the required dice to the part."},{"statement":"Only one point of damage is dealt each time a roll condition is met and the required dice are allocated.","sourceSentence":"(Only 1 point of damage is dealt each time a roll condition is met and the required dice are allocated.)","numericValue":{"magnitude":1,"unit":"point of damage","approximate":false}},{"statement":"Some machine parts are damaged with a single die, while others require a specific combination of two or three dice.","sourceSentence":"Some parts can be damaged by a single dice, others require a specific combo of 2-3 dice.","numericValue":{"magnitude":3,"unit":"dice (maximum in a combo)","approximate":false}},{"statement":"When a part is damaged, its yellow HP die is rotated down by one pip.","sourceSentence":"When a part is successfully damaged, rotate the part's yellow HP die face to reduce it by 1 pip, then place the dice you used to damage that part below the card.","numericValue":{"magnitude":1,"unit":"pip","approximate":false}},{"statement":"Dice used to damage a part are placed below that card.","sourceSentence":"When a part is successfully damaged, rotate the part's yellow HP die face to reduce it by 1 pip, then place the dice you used to damage that part below the card."},{"statement":"Dice spent on damaging a part cannot be re-used until the player's next turn.","sourceSentence":"These dice are spent and cannot be re-used until your next turn."},{"statement":"A machine part may be damaged more than once in a single turn, provided the player has enough dice to fully satisfy the damage condition each time.","sourceSentence":"A machine part can be damaged more than once per turn, but you must have enough dice to completely fulfill the damage condition each time."},{"statement":"Once all of the player's dice are allocated and resolved, or no playable dice remain, play proceeds to the Machine Phase.","sourceSentence":"When all of your dice have been allocated and resolved, and/or you have no more playable dice to play, proceed to the Machine Phase."},{"statement":"The player actions are numbered in order: activating utilities is action 1, playing dice to shields is action 2, and dealing damage to machine parts is action 3.","sourceSentence":"\"1) ACTIVATE ANY AVAILABLE UTILITIES\" ... \"2) PLAY DICE TO YOUR SHIELDS\" ... \"3) DEAL DAMAGE TO MACHINE PARTS\""}]}
